title: Spatial Contract v1 -- Criterion Decision Result
$comment: Stage D1 frozen contract. Reconciles two prior, structurally different shapes rather than picking one blind: (a) scripts/drawn_response/schemas/criterion_decision_record.schema.json's research-protocol shape (decision: MET/NOT_MET/ABSTAIN/NOT_APPLICABLE, reason_code, cited_observation_ids, method, rubric_version), defined by TASK-0011_PHASE_1_EXECUTION_SPEC.md sections 4.1/4.2/6.3/7.2; and (b) the criterion_statuses[] shape actually used by the running grading calls verified in decision_0045_verification_2026_08_19 (status: earned/not_earned/unable_to_determine, confidence, rationale). This v1 contract adopts (b)'s status vocabulary as canonical (it is what production grading calls already emit) and layers (a)'s citation/rubric-contract discipline on top, since (b) as measured had NO observation citation at all -- see SPATIAL_CONTRACT.md section 2.5 for the full mapping table (MET->earned, NOT_MET->not_earned, ABSTAIN->unable_to_determine, NOT_APPLICABLE->not_applicable) and the explicit statement that decision_0045_verification's raw JSONL output is NOT itself a conforming criterion_decision_result until backfit with cited_observation_ids and a rubric_contract reference (it has neither today). This is the third non-negotiable record type: it MUST cite locked visual_observation_result IDs and the applicable rubric_contract; it must never assert a fact about the image directly. confidence here is model self-reported diagnostic metadata only (per the Phase D prompt's non-negotiable architecture) and must never be read by any downstream system as a release control -- confidence_and_abstention_result.v1 is the only record type authorized to gate release, and it must be backed by measured calibration evidence, not this field.

criterion_decision_id.description: Unique ID for this decision record.

criterion_id.description: Item-specific criterion instance ID from that item's authored criterion_definitions package (e.g. 'DRG-P1-01-UNCERTAINTY_MARKS').

criterion_label.description: Shared cross-item criterion taxonomy, used for by-criterion rollups. Not a closed vocabulary forever -- CROSS_SUBJECT_MAPPING.md documents which of these already generalize across subjects and which subject-specific extensions would need a new versioned criterion_label set before use.

archetype.description: The exactly-3 V1-frozen archetypes confirmed in Stage D0 (matching the naming used by decision_0045_verification_2026_08_19 and ENGINE4_PRODUCTION_DESIGN_2026_08_18.md; equivalent to the *_with_* naming in partition_manifest.schema.json). A criterion decision for any response outside these 3 archetypes must not exist -- see CROSS_SUBJECT_MAPPING.md; unsupported forms abstain at capture/observation triage, before a criterion_decision_result is ever created.

status.description: Canonical status vocabulary, matching production grading-call output (criterion_statuses[]). Maps 1:1 from the research-protocol 'decision' enum: MET->earned, NOT_MET->not_earned, ABSTAIN->unable_to_determine, NOT_APPLICABLE->not_applicable.

cited_observation_ids.description: observation_id values from visual_observation_result.v1 records this decision relies on. Empty only when status is 'not_applicable'. Citation-integrity tests (validate_phase_d_contracts.py) fail closed if any cited ID does not resolve to a real observation in the same evaluation batch.

rubric_id.description: The item's authored criterion_definitions package ID this decision was scored against.

rubric_version.description: Must match an item's locked criterion_definitions version. A rubric defect invalidates affected decisions and requires a new rubric_version, not a silent edit.

rubric_contract.description: The applicable rubric contract this decision cites, per the Phase D prompt's non-negotiable architecture ('criterion decisions must cite ... the applicable rubric contract').

confidence.description: Model or human self-reported confidence. Diagnostic metadata ONLY -- never a release control (Phase D prompt, non-negotiable architecture). Downstream release gating must read confidence_and_abstention_result.v1 instead, never this field.

rationale.description: Free-text explanation, matching the production grading-call shape. Not a substitute for cited_observation_ids -- rationale is for human legibility, citations are what other records may rely on programmatically.

reviewer_id.description: For automated method output, use the method/run identifier (see 'method') rather than a human reviewer ID.

method.description: Distinguishes gold human labels from the candidate automated methods and the DECISION-0045 AI-verification pass. 'method_decision_0045_verifier' added in v1 to accommodate the already-executed Gemini/Qwen verification pass once it is backfit with citations (see $comment).
